scope: staging infrastructure changes applied through GitHub Actions
terraformPlanAndApply.observedOutcome: GitHub Actions plan and apply succeeded after IAM policy changes; the subsequent Terraform plan reported no changes.

applyExecutionControl.observedOutcome: Apply does not execute automatically on push; it is invoked through workflow_dispatch.
applyExecutionControl.limitation: This does not establish a mandatory human approval gate.

iamManagedPolicyRemoval.observedOutcome: No attached AWS managed policies were returned by list-attached-role-policies.
iamManagedPolicyRemoval.limitation: Successful workflow execution does not prove that every inline permission satisfies least privilege.

metrics.reason: Correctness, controlled infrastructure changes, post-apply reconciliation, and IAM policy configuration are the primary validation objectives; no artificial performance metric is needed.

limitations: Validation is limited to Staging; Production infrastructure provisioning and application were not demonstrated.
No claim of exhaustive least-privilege compliance for the Terraform apply role.
No claim of mandatory human approval for apply execution.
No claim of state recovery or disaster-recovery validation.
No claim of production-scale reliability or multi-region resilience.
